sentences.text: Counsel for Petitioner :- Daya Shanker Pandey

Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.,Rakesh Kumar Pandey Hon'ble Anjani Kumar Mishra,J.
Hon'ble Shiv Shanker Prasad,J.
Shri Rakesh Kumar Pandey has filed his appearance on behalf of respondent no.3 in Court today.
The same is taken on record.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and counsel for the first informant, respondent no.3 as also learned AGA for the State-respondents.

The instant petition seeks quashing of the impugned F.I.R. dated 24.02.2022 giving rise to Case Crime No. 65 of 2022, under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 IPC and 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act,
Police Station Bindki, District Fatehpur.
Vipin Prakash Dubey And 5 Others vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 17 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/86219111/

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Upon hearing learned counsel for the parties, we find that submissions made on behalf of the petitioners are his defence, which cannot be looked into while dealing with a writ petition seeking quashing of a first information report.
Moreover, the allegations made in the First Information Report clearly disclose commission of cognizable offences and the allegations are serious in nature.
Therefore, prayer of the petitioner to quash the First Information Report is completely misconceived and is rejected.
The writ petition is therefore dismissed, without prejudice to the right of the petitioner to apply for bail/ anticipatory bail.

Order Date :- 17.7.2023 RKM  Vipin Prakash Dubey And 5 Others vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 17 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/86219111/
